about.tooltip: I really appreciate that you visited here.
aboutText: I am Pavlo, a Junior Front-End Developer actively growing in the field of modern web technologies. After obtaining a law degree, I decided to change direction and dove into the world of IT.

My journey began with learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Later, I started building my own projects using React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and worked with REST APIs, MongoDB, Node.js, and other modern tools. I value clarity, structure, and minimalism in development, and always strive for high-quality results.

Although I am only at the beginning of my professional path, I am ready to approach learning new technologies responsibly, actively collaborate in an IT team, participate in real projects, and constantly improve my skills.
My goal is to grow in Front-End, work in a modern team, create useful products, and never stop progressing.
